current.text: Experts expect him to start for Memphis on the wing, next to Ty Jerome, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Experts expect more minutes than last season. Estimates range from about 28 to over 30 minutes a night. Joe expects only Coward and Cameron Boozer to top 30 minutes on Memphis.
Most experts expect a second-year jump with more usage, more shots and more free throws. One expert calls him one of the bigger breakout players this season. His assists can also improve.
The newest expert view is more cautious: he is somewhat hopeful but worried Coward lacks an extra gear, because he did not step up when given the chance last season.
Experts see a fair draft spot around picks 87 to 100. His Yahoo ADP of 87 is called right on, and he is better value on ESPN, where he goes around 124.
In an auction mock, Josh valued him at about 6 USD.
Memphis coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short, hard stints and a deep rotation of 11 or 12 players, which spreads minutes across the roster.
Memphis has a full 4-4-4 game schedule in our fantasy playoff weeks (season end March 28) and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is not a steals or blocks player. Experts agree his defensive stats are weak, and steals are his weakest projected category.
Experts disagree on his rebounding. Joe sees him as a rebounding shooting guard, while another expert calls him a middling rebounder. His projected rebounds are well above average for his position.
He is a third-option scorer who knocks down open shots. Joe also calls him a strong defender.
He has a good archetype but is old for a second-year player, and he has not yet shown he can raise his usage or volume.

note: Experts put Coward around picks 87 to 100. In a 144-player draft, that makes him a mid-to-late starter or bench piece. Josh's 6 USD auction value is a fair bid, sitting between ESPN's 1 USD and Yahoo's 12 USD. He has no weak flagged category, so he fits any build, though his low steals mean he does little for steals-focused teams. Early in the season, check whether he plays 28 or more minutes in Iisalo's deep rotation and whether his shot volume rises from last season's 10.5 attempts. His Memphis schedule (4-4-4 in the playoffs, few back-to-backs) is a small bonus.
